AF-01
Reviewed opt in
Change the automatic option before and after approval.
Option defaults off; approved content changes only through review; a pending update blocks dispatch.
AF-02
Consent window
Exercise T−5 minus a tick, T−5, start minus a tick and start.
Consent accepted only in [T−5,start), using backend time; confirmation alone sends no start.
AF-03
Identity and authorization
Use another owner, wrong UID/UAV, expired/revoked lease or inactive UAV.
Access is denied or dispatch blocked; no aircraft command is issued.
AF-04
Freshness gates
Expire presence, heartbeat, telemetry and preflight independently.
The relevant gate blocks dispatch; restoring one condition cannot bypass the others.
AF-05
Changed execution context
Confirm, then replace plan, connection or uploaded mission.
Consent/read-back binding is invalidated; stale hashes cannot authorize execution.
AF-06
Cancel and missed window
Cancel before dispatch, hide tab, lose session and reconnect after deadline.
No implied consent or late catch-up start; cancelled authorization remains unusable.
AF-07
Plan and unit contract
Export owner/non-owner plans; test degrees/E7, altitude frame and missing values.
Correct units/order and scope; null altitude is rejected; dispatchEnabled reflects all gates.
AF-08
Eligible scheduled execution
Provide approved plan, verified upload, valid consent and all fresh gates at start.
One execution envelope reaches the correct gateway; no early arm/start; InProgress requires actual flight evidence.
AF-09
Firmware and payload capability
Use supported profiles, unsupported firmware and a missing-camera photo action.
Supported profile compiles; incompatible airframe/frame/action blocks before execution.
AF-10
Upload read-back integrity
Inject upload timeout, rejected ACK, reordered/wrong downloaded items and hash mismatch.
Bounded failure is visible; no dispatch until normalized read-back matches the compiled mission.
AF-11
Replay and delivery retry
Duplicate/reorder one commandId across reconnects and workers.
Same identity is deduplicated; delivery retries do not repeat physical start or create another execution.
AF-12
ACK versus flight evidence
Accept command ACK while vehicle remains on ground; then supply valid flight-state evidence.
ACK alone leaves mission Approved; one trusted execution/InProgress transition follows observed flight evidence.
AF-13
Dispatch deadline
Deliver immediately before and after scheduled start plus 5 seconds.
Only a valid, still-eligible envelope within deadline can execute; expired dispatch never catches up.
AF-14
Restart and uncertain outcome
Restart backend/gateway after accepting an envelope and during an uncertain start.
Durable identity survives; reconcile observed state; do not blindly re-arm or restart.
AF-15
Loss and pilot takeover
Lose web/backend link during an airborne SITL mission; exercise RC takeover.
Configured onboard failsafe and pilot authority apply; history remains traceable; no automatic duplicate launch.
AF-16
Completion and partial outcome
Repeat trusted completion; record an aborted/partial flight with telemetry gaps.
One execution/report; outcome and missing coverage remain explicit; no fabricated completed route.
